description: This file implements a call graph directed acyclic graph (DAG) for functions, including classes and methods for creating, traversing, and analyzing function call relationships, with focus on topological order and recursion detection.

classes.name: CallDAG::CallDAGCreator
classes.description: Helper class for creating and analyzing the call graph DAG, including traversal, index assignment, and recursion detection.

classes.name: CallDAG
classes.description: Main class representing the call graph DAG, with methods for initialization, querying, and management.

methods.name: CallDAG::init
methods.description: Initializes the call DAG from an AST root node, performing traversal, topological sort, and recursion detection.

methods.name: CallDAG::size
methods.description: Returns the number of function records in the DAG.

methods.name: CallDAG::findIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a function in the DAG given its unique ID.

methods.name: CallDAG::getRecordFromIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the call graph record at a specified index.

methods.name: CallDAG::clear
methods.description: Clears the call graph data structures.
